title: Cyclones, anticyclones & local storms
quote: Eye = calm, lowest pressure; eyewall = strongest winds

boxes.title: Tropical cyclone formation
items: SST above ==**26.5 °C**== (⚠ other notes: 27 degC); only over warm oceans
Coriolis force, low vertical wind shear, pre-existing disturbance
Belt ==**30 deg N - 30 deg S**== (APPSC 2022); not within **5 deg** of equator
None in **South Atlantic**, south-east Pacific
NH anticlockwise; Southern Hemisphere clockwise; die on landfall

boxes.title: Anticyclones, tornadoes, Western Disturbances
items: **Anticyclone**: high centre, outward sinking air; clockwise in NH; clear weather
**Tornado**: funnel from thunderstorm, **105-322 km/h**; USA (Gulf of Mexico air)
**Western Disturbance**: ==**Mediterranean**== origin, steered by STJ; winter rain → **Rabi**
**Kaal Baisakhi**: Bengal, Assam; **Aandhi**: NW India
**Damini App**: lightning alerts in **15** languages

boxes.title: India's exposure
